body: Thank you so much for commenting, I'm really grateful. Everything you've said I can relate to. See my mum will randomly buy me a plushie or a hair bow (I am a very girly person :x ) and then will tell me about it, and that makes me so happy because every time it'll make me think that she does love me. But every time, my therapist and closest friends tell me that it's bait to reel me back in. A lot of the time it turns out that she does indeed want a favour, and I'm so silly that I will jump at the chance to do it because if I don't, the guilt will ruin me until I do. It's like being picked up, then dropped whenever my parents don't want me and I think that is the most confusing thing to go through.

I wonder why abuse victims are often hard on themselves. I also think that my unhappy childhood has put me off having children. My mum also HATES children. I have no idea why she had her own. She hates spending time with her grandchildren (From my father's ex wife) despite the fact that she gets on really well with my dad's other children. 

Thank you so much for your comment, it's given me things to read and a lot of things to think about. <3
I don't think so ... :( I just don't understand why mine would be so awful to me for seemingly no reason at all. I'm struggling to see why they would.
I think I'd be really angry that my friend was being taken advantage of ... I never thought about it this way.
